subject.title: fix(auto-reply): gate execution-phase typing in message mode (#111547)

question: Should `typingMode: "message"` continue to indicate active execution before text, as current code and documentation state, or be redefined to wait strictly for renderable assistant text?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes an existing configuration mode and the default behavior of some group chats; source and public documentation currently agree on the behavior being removed.

options.title: Keep the current contract
options.body: Close or retarget this PR because active execution remains a supported trigger for `message` mode.

options.title: Redefine message mode
options.body: Approve the text-only interpretation, revise the public contract, and require real channel proof before landing.

recommendation.title: Keep the current contract
recommendation.body: Close or retarget this PR because active execution remains a supported trigger for `message` mode.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the canonical field report and the clearest concrete user scenario, though final product direction requires a repository decision-maker.
